title: [3.1.0.3] NSClient synchronisation stops loop and is extemely slow
symptom: NSClient upload queue has ~180k entries and after 4.5 hours only down to ~160k, then stagnates at ~90k. Restarting NSClient, AAPS, NS, or phone doesn't help. While NSClient is uploading, the loop stops working (manual runs show 'no APS selected').
cause: The thread suggests a race condition or busy phone causing the loop to stop, but maintainer MilosKozak states it's not intended and is a result of busy phone, and that disabling broadcast will speed up the process. The exact root cause is not definitively established.
fix: Disabling local broadcast and upload to NS in xDrip+ allowed uploading all data in a couple of hours. Also, pausing NSClient makes the loop work. MilosKozak suggests trying dev branch as sync has been improved, and mentions sync is new in 3.2.
settings_changed: upload to NS in XDrip+ → disabled
evidence_quote: This is unlikely, as deactivating the local broadcast and upload to NS in XDrip+ enabled us to upload all data in a couple of hours.
